title: Serverless DB Connection Pooling Pattern
description: Runnable connection-pooling examples for AWS Lambda: a Python handler reusing a warm psycopg2 connection through PgBouncer, a Node.js pg Pool with max=1 behind RDS Proxy, a Java HikariCP config for transaction pooling, and a reference pgbouncer.ini.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de connection pooling para AWS Lambda: handler Python que reutiliza una conexión psycopg2 caliente a través de PgBouncer, Pool de Node.js pg con max=1 detrás de RDS Proxy, config Java HikariCP para transaction pooling y un pgbouncer.ini de referencia.
